question.stem: Which of the following information should the nurse include?
question.preamble: The home-health nurse is teaching the parents of a 4-year-old client with impetigo.

options.text: “Put a surgical mask on your child when around siblings.”
“Cleanse the lesions with a povidone-iodine solution daily.”
“Apply petroleum jelly to the lesions daily.”
“Instruct your child not to use the same towels as siblings.”

question.explanation: Impetigo spreads by direct and indirect contact (including shared linens and towels), so not sharing towels with siblings (Option 4) is standard, correct contact-precaution teaching. A mask (Option 1) is unnecessary, since impetigo does not spread by the respiratory route. Daily cleansing is typically with gentle soap and water rather than povidone-iodine (Option 2). Petroleum jelly (Option 3) is not the standard treatment; prescribed topical or oral antibiotics are used instead, and an occlusive ointment is not the recommended lesion care.
